name: recovery_key_scan
description: Sweep a directory tree or a blob for key material a case can use: BitLocker 48-digit recovery passwords, BitLocker key files, LUKS and SSH private keys, keychain and key database files, and the file names people save a recovery key under.

path.description: A directory to walk, or a single blob to sweep

max_bytes_per_file.description: How much of each file to read (default 8388608)
